description: Use when someone is preparing a lab or point-of-care testing service for an inspection or accreditation and wants to know what inspectors look for (e.g. 'what do I need for a CLIA inspection?', 'CAP checklist for QC and competency', 'ISO 15189:2022 readiness', 'UK POCT governance checklist'). Returns a practical checklist (quality control, competency, EQA or proficiency testing, document control, audit trail, result reporting, equipment) with the evidence usually asked for, and which Catenix module keeps those records. General guidance, not legal or regulatory advice.

framework.description: clia (US CLIA), cap (CAP accreditation), iso_15189 (ISO 15189:2022), uk_poct (UK POCT governance, MHRA guidance).

name: inspection_checklist
title: Lab inspection readiness checklist (CLIA, CAP, ISO 15189, UK POCT)
